statement: For every nonzero r in Z_3, r=3^k e, the entire global section fiber of the actual inherited quotient H with first class 3r kappa_3(3) has topological coordinates Z_3 times R(P_k) times Z_3^((3^(k+1)-1)/2) times Z_3[[Z]], where P_k consists exactly of p other than3 with v_3(ord_p(3)) at most k+1. The exact toric map and unique unramified cocycle normal form are computed. An explicit arithmetic automorphism handles e, and actual field norm lifts split the restricted residue map. Together with E.47 this computes every H fiber whose first coordinate is unramified outside3.
where_proved: sections/E_unramified_first.tex, E.51 and its complete proof; code/e_unramified_first.py/.out/.json

notes: The map (a,v(T)) to (ea,v(T^e)) is an actual arithmetic automorphism. The integral finite invariant is the inversion-fixed part of Z_3[C_M]; the remaining coordinate is exactly T^M W f(W^2). Every global residue lift is constructed by norm equations after proving all required class-group and unit-norm properties. The intrinsic kernels remain and no intrinsic lift is asserted.
